column2: A black moon!
What on earth is that...!?
Akira, isn't that light pointing toward Science City?
Science City? Something's happened to {p} and the others...!
Don't go!
You okay, {p}?
Akira-kun, I... What happened?
You were saying "take me with you."
You don't remember?
Talk later...!
...Right.
Don't you guys let your guard down!
Akira-kun...!
Just shut up and watch! Let's go, Shusha! Shinichi!
{p}-kun, please don't leave this hotel for a while.
Why not?
Look outside and you'll understand...
Get out! Showing {p} a mess like this!
Y-yikes!
...This is terrible.
The fear of not knowing when a black fiend might latch onto your body and control you... Humans gripped by suspicion... there's no telling what they'll do!
This is human weakness!
Humans have the courage to hold down their fear and fight! The human spirit ain't that weak, Ryo.
Exactly right!
But the situation could go either way.\n\nPeople driven by fear are turning into a mob. We need to sort out and analyze the situation, quickly.
Now, Akira-kun, Ryo-kun, would you tell us how things were when you arrived in Science City?
...Sure.
...Something's wrong? What the hell happened!?
What is it, Akira? Worried about the Makimuras?
Don't worry, Bokuto Masa will protect those kids.
Ryo! Look at that!
Eeeek!
You bastard!
Wait, Akira!
...As you command.
Huh!?
Come on!
What the hell are these guys!?
Look, Akira! There are black things all over...
The people are being controlled by black things...?
While we were following the controlled people, we came upon the incident on the roof.
I'm told the people controlled by the black things...\n\nall say they heard someone's voice. We shall have to find out just what words they heard.
Hold on, Dr. Saotome.
What is it?
Don't you got anything to say to {p}?
What!?
Stop it, Akira!
...Dr. Saotome, what about {s}...?
I understand how you feel about {s}. But there's something I want you to understand, too.

The Dimension Chain phenomenon is still going on.\n\nAnd the tragedy the black moon brings has entered its next stage. The black moon has breathed life back into the remains of the "Ma," and they've become black things, black fiends, attacking people.
People possessed by the black fiends turn into rioters, controlled by the Demon King. The damage only spreads... In other words, the Demon King's power is growing!
This situation is a threat to mankind! As director of the Saotome Lab, I have to work to save mankind! Whatever the sacrifice!
You're telling {s} to be the sacrifice!?
I want to do everything I can too! I don't want to sacrifice a single person!
Dr. Saotome... you...
But! Right now the situation doesn't allow for that!
Please understand... all of you.
Dr. Saotome, the Getter Team has launched.
Then let's go see how the people controlled by the black things are doing.
...All those people outside want me handed over to the Demon King?
Among the people controlled by the black things, there's apparently a scientist who was studying the Dimension Chain. For some reason, he's stirring them up, saying "Hand him over to the Demon King!"
Why?
Because there's a rumor that {s}, who came from the same world as you, was drawn into the black moon.
...Just because of that?
Take a good look, Akira!\n\nThe humans you're trying to protect are dancing to the black fiends' tune and becoming your enemy. Tomorrow it could be you.
But {p}'s a victim in all this too!
Not to the people outside! To them he's involved!
Stop it, you two!\n\nIf you start fighting too, it's playing right into the Demon King's hands!
...You're right. Sorry.
A hard fight awaits you, {p}.
The people support the Demon King.\n\nYou'll have to fight against them!

Hey, Ryo...

Did I really...

have to become Devilman?
It was necessary for you to survive!
Surviving was never supposed to be the real goal, was it...?
If there'd never been any Dimension Chain, maybe I wouldn't have had to become Devilman...
Akira-kun...
It's a mess down there. The number of rioters keeps growing by the minute.
We risked our lives protecting mankind from the Dinosaur Empire, and this is what we get. Makes me sick.
I'm worried about what's goin' on down there. Wanna drop down for a look?
Let's do that.
What do ya mean a Mechasaurus survived?
You didn't notice, Musashi?
Notice what?
There was a black thing stuck to the Mechasaurus...
Yeeeegads!\n\nSo even the Mechasaurus is bein' controlled by black things?
Maybe the Mechasaurus came back to life, the same way the remains of the "Ma" did when the black moon's light hit them.
Hey, hey! Were the black fiends always that huge!?
...Better report to Dr. Saotome.
Right, back to the lab!
How long are you planning to keep this up, Ryo?
Calm down, Akira.\n\nEven if you go out there now, nothing will change.
